description: Change an existing template: name, description, size, background, default video duration, layers or pages. Use this to edit a design, resize it, or add sizes to a multi-size template. Layers are matched by their 'layer' name: an existing layer is updated in place and a new name is added. Top-level 'layers' apply to the first page; 'pages' reaches the others. With replaceLayers true, layers missing from the request are deleted. To move a layer, send both x and y (a missing coordinate is set to 0). In 'pages', a page name that doesn't exist yet is added and an existing page has its layers updated. On a multi-size template, set width and height per page inside 'pages'; top-level width and height are rejected there because they would resize every page. Returns the updated template.

duration.description: Default video duration in milliseconds for MP4 renders (e.g., 5000 for 5 seconds)

height.description: New height in pixels. Applies to every page; rejected on multi-size templates (use per-page height inside 'pages')

layers.description: Layer definitions. Each has 'layer' (its unique name) and 'type' (text, image, shape or rating).

animation.description: Animation config for video (MP4) renders. All time values in milliseconds.

layer.description: Unique layer name. The field is called 'layer'; there is no 'name' field.

pages.description: Pages for a multi-page or multi-size template (for example an Instagram square, a story and an X landscape version in one template, each with its own width and height). Used in place of top-level 'layers'. Each page has 'page' (a unique name), optional 'width'/'height' (default: the template size), and 'layers' as an object keyed by layer name, the same shape get_template_pages returns.

height.description: Page height in pixels (defaults to template height)

hide.description: On update_template, true deletes the page from the template

width.description: Page width in pixels (defaults to template width)

replaceLayers.description: true: delete the layers (on the pages being updated) that are missing from the request. false (default): keep them.

width.description: New width in pixels. Applies to every page; rejected on multi-size templates (use per-page width inside 'pages')

name: update_template
